description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling matrix reactions, including normalization, content building, relation path construction, annotation extraction, summarization, and selection of user-specific reaction event IDs.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixReactionMessageId
methods.description: Trims and validates a message ID for matrix reactions.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixReactionEmoji
methods.description: Trims and validates an emoji string for matrix reactions.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionContent
methods.description: Constructs matrix reaction content object with normalized message ID and emoji.

methods.name: buildMatrixReactionRelationsPath
methods.description: Builds a URL path for matrix reaction relations based on room ID and message ID.

methods.name: extractMatrixReactionAnnotation
methods.description: Extracts reaction annotation details from content object.

methods.name: extractMatrixReactionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the reaction key from content.

methods.name: summarizeMatrixReactionEvents
methods.description: Generates summaries of reactions, counting occurrences and users per reaction key.

methods.name: selectOwnMatrixReactionEventIds
methods.description: Selects event IDs of reactions made by a specific user, optionally filtered by emoji.
